_about: One place for every language Maatu speaks. The voice agent (agent/languages.py) and the web app (lib/languages.ts) both read this file, so a voice or recognition fix made here applies to every call, every Hear it button and every coach check at once.

engine: 'sarvam' = Sarvam recognition locked to the language, the Gemini teaching brain, and a fixed Sarvam voice that reads native script (sounds local and never drifts). 'gemini-live' = one Google model that hears and speaks (French only: Sarvam has no French voice).
voiceModel + speakers: the Sarvam voice used on live calls. When speakers is empty, each character keeps its own Bulbul v3 voice from its persona file.
teacher.voice: the Bulbul v3 voice for the teacher, the Hear it button and spoken coach notes.
To add a language: add one block here, then add its persona files and curriculum entries. No em dashes anywhere.
